criteria.BOS_or_other_special_tokens: Exclude all in C/U; no artificial BOS insertion
criteria.UTF8: Require exact UTF8 history and8-token tail recovery; never retokenize/repair
criteria.readability: At least one。and30 Japanese characters in retained histories
criteria.year_group: Exactly2 cases per8 years per group, if constraints can be met; otherwise stop without inference
criteria.page: 32 distinct C pages and32 disjoint U pages
criteria.heading: 64 distinct NFKC/number-prefix-normalized heading strings, not semantic-family independence
criteria.topic: Fixed keyword proxy; different primary topics, no reciprocal specific-keyword overlap; human full-history review required before freeze
criteria.nonmata: 8 content/other,4 demonstrative,4 other connector; max2 per gold BPE ID
criteria.donor: Prefer same year; if unavailable choose other year and record. Left crop original token prefix to exact C length; require UTF8, readability and no specials.

decoder: Default positions0..L-1, batch1/no padding, eval/dropout off, full3997-vocab softmax; no LF/special exclusion or penalties
principal: Delta=logP(g|C)-logP(g|U), strict-positive count; not semantic success. Report overall balanced sample plus each16-case group; not population-representative.
logits_reuse: Reuse exact B checkpoint+input token tuple from saved B archive; no reuse from other checkpoints.

auxiliary.limits: Same original C tail given to both histories; prefix+7<=255; not free generation or knowledge-of-word segmentation.

freeze: Write FREEZE only after semantic pair review; runner checks all source/code/input hashes.
sampling: 16/16 and4 cases per year are deliberately balanced, NOT a population sample; TRAIN Mata prior241/1853.
auxiliary_argmax_divergence: Record any numeric branch; do not silently alter primary predictions.
semantic_review: PAIR_REVIEW.json, including pre-inference refinement history. No predictions used in selection.
